app.title: Exfiltrate Your Weights

app.description: A utility to download and organize machine‑learning model weights from various providers into a local, searchable index.
proposed_tests: Download a small open-source model (e.g., gpt2) and verify file integrity
Index the downloaded weights and perform a local search query
